text:
Alex T: @Maria G @Jin H @Sara P kicking off the VoltEdge joint perf bench. Goals: perf/W, throughput at steady-state, kernel tuning, and press-friendly numbers. :wave:
Maria G: Proposed scope: resnet-like throughput, llama-like generation, long-context sim. Batch sizes 1/8/32, seq lengths 512/2048, quantization int8 plus fp16 baseline. Short and sweet.
Jin H: Add KV-cache warmup scenarios and cold-start (empty KV) cases. Need telemetry tags for kernel version, driver, and power cap.
Sara P: Who owns telemetry ingestion and data-sharing with VoltEdge? Legal signoff needed for raw traces.
Alex T: BenchBot will upload aggregated CSVs; raw traces need partner agreement. @BenchBot can you start a run template for the dry-run? :eyes: 
BenchBot: Scheduled bench run: voltedge-dryrun-2026-03-25T09Z. Artifacts target: s3://redwood-partner/voltedge/bench-2288002468/. Config snippet attached:
```
model: llm-large
quant: int8
batches: [1,8,32]
seqs: [512,2048]
driver: nvidia-535.54
power_cap_w: [200,250,300]
notes: kv_warmup=true
```
Maria G: For perf/W we need per-sample energy. Can VoltEdge expose per-socket power counters and synchronized timestamps (NTP/ptp)?
Jin H: Yes please. Recommend 5 runs per config, drop first 2 as warmup, report median and p95. Use perf_counter mapping and include kernel_hash. Example run command:
```
./run_bench.sh --config voltedge.yaml --iters 7 --save telemetry.json
```
Alex T: Measurement sheet (shared): columns = config_id, model, batch, seq, driver, kernel_hash, power_avg_w, tokens_per_sec, p95_latency_ms, notes
Sara P: Press/partner timeline suggestion: 3/25 dry run, 4/1 internal review with VoltEdge, 4/8 embargoed joint announcement. Need a comms owner and a secure artifact share.
Maria G: I'll own comms and the visuals. Jin — can you draft a kernel-tuning playbook for VoltEdge with concrete steps: matmul kernel variants, thread/block tiling, prefetch hints, and smoke-test patches?
Jin H: Yep. I'll add a short checklist and sample patches. Will request SSH access to VoltEdge lab machines.
Alex T: Action summary: Maria confirm telemetry/data contract; Jin prepare kernel playbook + sample patches; BenchBot run dry-run 3/25; Sara coordinate press calendar and partner invites. :rocket:
Sara P: Noted. I'll put calendar invites and include partner PMs + legal.
Maria G: Internal doc (read-only): https://redwood.internal/docs/bench/voltedge-integration — contains templates and measurement spreadsheet.
Alex T: Thanks team — please update this thread with blockers. Keep messages short so we can forward a sanitized log to the partner.
